blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deepfake detection methods have become increasingly effective yet most provide limited insight into the evidence behind their predictions. However, in forensic settings users also need to know which manipulation cues support the decision and where they appear. Existing explainability methods only partially address this need since localization-based approaches lack semantic descriptions while language-based explanation methods are only weakly grounded in visual evidence. In this work, we propose DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck model for explainable deepfake detection. DF-CBM builds a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts from textual artifact annotations and links each concept to plausible facial and boundary regions. It then predicts these concepts from visual features using a concept-specific masked attention mechanism guided by parsed facial masks and the final real/fake decision is made from the predicted concept bottleneck. Our experiments show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in concept prediction and deepfake classification while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art black-box detectors. Finally, qualitative results and intervention analyses demonstrate that DF-CBM provides spatially grounded concept evidence and enables counterfactual explanations of how individual manipulation concepts influence the final prediction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/DF-CBM .
blocks.zh: 深假探测方法已变得日益有效,但大多数方法对其预测背后的证据的洞察力有限。 然而,在法证环境中,用户还需要知道哪些操纵提示支持决定以及它们出现在何处。 现有的可解释性方法仅部分地满足了这一需要,因为基于本地化的方法缺乏语义描述,而基于语言的解释方法则仅以视觉证据为薄弱的基础. 在这项工作中,我们提出了DF-CBM,一种区域意识的概念瓶颈模型,用于解释性的深假检测. DF-CBM从文字文物说明中构建了与操纵相关的概念的紧凑词汇,并将每个概念与可信的面部和边界区域联系起来. 然后,它利用一个以解面罩为指南的概念特异性蒙蔽的注意力机制,从视觉特征中预测这些概念,最后真实/假决定由预测的概念瓶颈作出. 我们的实验显示,DF-CBM在概念预测和深假分类方面超越了基于概念的基线,同时仍然与最先进的黑盒探测器具有竞争力. 最后,定性结果和干预分析表明,DF-CBM提供了基于空间的概念证据,能够对个人操纵概念如何影响最终预测作出反事实解释。 我们的代码可在https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/DF-CBM上查阅。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in generative modeling [ 12 , 22 , 40 , 51 , 67 ] have enabled the synthesis and manipulation of highly realistic visual media commonly referred to as deepfakes [ 36 ] . While these technologies have beneficial applications in entertainment [ 6 , 32 ] , media production [ 70 ] and digital art [ 14 ] , they also create substantial opportunities for misuse including political disinformation, identity fraud, coordinated misinformation campaigns and non-consensual content generation [ 24 , 53 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近基因模型化[12,22,40,51,67]的进步,使得能够合成和操纵被通常称为深假的高度现实的视觉媒体[36]. 虽然这些技术在娱乐[6,32],媒体制作[70]和数字艺术[14]方面都有有益的应用,但它们也为滥用创造了大量机会,包括政治假象、身份欺诈、协调的假象宣传以及未经同意的内容生成[24,53]。

blocks.en: To address these risks, a wide range of deepfake detection methods have been developed to distinguish authentic from manipulated content [ 41 , 29 , 44 , 7 , 46 ] . Yet, despite substantial progress, many detectors remain limited by their black-box nature providing little insight into the visual evidence that drives their predictions. This lack of transparency is particularly problematic in forensic and high-stakes settings where reliable decision-making requires not only accurate predictions but also explanations that are transparent, verifiable and suitable for human oversight.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些风险,开发了广泛的深假检测方法,以区分真实性和被操纵的内容[41、29、44、7、46]。 然而,尽管取得了很大进展,但许多探测器仍然受到其黑盒性质的限制,对驱动其预测的视觉证据几乎没有什么见解。 这种缺乏透明度的情况在法医和高考环境中尤其成问题,在这些环境中,可靠的决策不仅需要准确的预测,而且需要透明、可核查和适合人类监督的解释。

blocks.en: Existing explainable deepfake detection methods mainly follow two directions, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . Localization-based approaches, such as saliency maps, attention visualizations and other post-hoc explanations, highlight image regions that influence a detector’s prediction [ 4 , 45 , 54 ] . However, these methods typically indicate where the model focuses without providing a semantic description of the forensic evidence. In contrast, recent MLLM-based approaches generate textual explanations that describe possible manipulation artifacts in natural language [ 48 , 69 , 17 , 58 ] . While more interpretable to humans, such explanations are often only weakly grounded in the image and may describe artifacts without establishing a precise correspondence to the supporting visual evidence. As a result, current methods either provide visual evidence without semantic concepts, or textual explanations without sufficiently reliable spatial grounding.
blocks.zh: 现有的可解释的深假检测方法主要遵循两个方向,如图所示. 1,基于本地化的方法,如显像图,注意力可视化和其他热后解释,突出影响探测器预测的图像区域[4,45,54]. 然而,这些方法通常指明模型的焦点所在,而没有对法医证据提供语义描述. 与此相反,最近基于MLLM的方法产生了文字解释,说明自然语言中可能的操纵文物[48、69、17、58]。 这种解释虽然更能对人类解释,但往往只是以图像为薄弱基础,可能描述文物,而无需与佐证的视觉证据建立精确的对应关系. 因此,目前的方法要么提供没有语义概念的视觉证据,要么提供没有充分可靠的空间定位的文字解释.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Explanation capabilities of existing deepfake detection approaches and DF-CBM that provides both localized visual evidence and grounded manipulation concepts.
blocks.zh: 图1:现有深假检测方法和DF-CBM的解释能力,既提供局部视觉证据,又提供有根据的操纵概念.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce DF-CBM, a visually grounded concept bottleneck framework for explainable deepfake detection. DF-CBM first constructs a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts and associates each concept with plausible facial or boundary regions. It then learns a region-aware concept bottleneck model that predicts these concepts from visual features while encouraging each concept to rely on the facial regions where that artifact is expected to appear. This way, each predicted manipulation concept is associated not only with a semantic label but also with localized visual evidence, improving the interpretability of the final deepfake prediction.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了DF-CBM,这是可解释的深层假象探测的视觉概念瓶颈框架。 DF-CBM首先构建了与操纵相关的概念的紧凑词汇,并将每个概念与可信的面部或边界区域联系起来. 然后它学习了一个区域意识的概念瓶颈模型,从视觉特征来预测这些概念,同时鼓励每个概念依赖那些预期会出现文物的面部区域. 这样,每个预测的操纵概念不仅与语义标签有关,而且与局部视觉证据有关,提高了最终深假预测的可解释性.

blocks.en: Notably, unlike conventional black-box detectors and post-hoc explanation methods, DF-CBM makes the intermediate forensic evidence explicit since the final prediction is obtained from predicted manipulation concepts rather than directly from unconstrained visual features. This enables counterfactual analyses and allows users to inspect which concepts contributed to the decision and where their supporting evidence appears in the image. We evaluate DF-CBM under intra-dataset and cross-dataset settings, comparing it against both state-of-the-art black-box detectors and concept-based baselines. Our results show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in both concept prediction and real/fake classification while achieving competitive detection performance against state-of-the-art detectors. We further provide qualitative attention maps and contribution scores to visualize the spatial evidence and decision-relevant concepts and conduct a concept intervention analysis to examine how modifying individual concept activations affects the final prediction. Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,与常规黑盒探测器和后热解析方法不同,DF-CBM使中间法证证据明确,因为最终预测来自预测的操纵概念,而不是直接来自不受约束的视觉特征. 这样可以进行反事实分析,使用户能够检查哪些概念有助于作出决定,以及其佐证证据出现在图像中。 我们在数据集和跨数据集设置下评价DF-CBM,将其与最先进的黑箱探测器和基于概念的基线进行比较. 我们的结果显示,DF-CBM在概念预测和真实/假分类方面都超过了基于概念的基线,同时相对于最先进的探测器实现了竞争性检测性能. 我们还提供了定性关注地图和贡献分数,以可视化空间证据和决策相关概念,并进行概念干预分析,以审查修改个人概念激活如何影响最终预测。 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck framework for explainable deepfake detection that predicts semantically meaningful manipulation concepts and grounds them in anatomically relevant facial regions. • We develop an automated pipeline for constructing and grounding forensic concepts, combining text-based concept extraction with facial parsing masks and concept-specific attention to support each concept prediction with localized visual evidence. • We demonstrate that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in both concept prediction and deepfake detection while achieving competitive detection performance against state-of-the-art black-box detectors and enhanced interpretability through attention maps, contribution scores and concept intervention analysis.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出DF-CBM,这是一个区域认识的概念瓶颈框架,用于可解释的深假检测,它预示着有目的的操纵概念,并在解剖相关面部区域中为这些概念提供依据。 我们开发一个自动管道,用于构建和奠定法医概念,将基于文字的概念提取与面部解剖口罩和针对具体概念的关注结合起来,以局部视觉证据支持每个概念的预测。 我们表明,DF-CBM在概念预测和深假探测方面都超过了基于概念的基线,同时通过注意地图、贡献分数和概念干预分析,实现与最先进的黑盒探测器相比的竞争性探测性能和增强可解释性。

blocks.en: We introduce DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck framework for explainable deepfake detection that predicts semantically meaningful manipulation concepts and grounds them in anatomically relevant facial regions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出DF-CBM,这是一个区域意识概念的瓶颈框架,用于可解释的深假检测,它预言了有目的的操纵概念,并将其置于解剖相关面部区域。

blocks.en: We develop an automated pipeline for constructing and grounding forensic concepts, combining text-based concept extraction with facial parsing masks and concept-specific attention to support each concept prediction with localized visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个自动管道,用于构建和定位法医概念,将基于文字的概念提取与面部解析口罩和针对具体概念的关注结合起来,以局部视觉证据支持每个概念预测.

blocks.en: We demonstrate that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in both concept prediction and deepfake detection while achieving competitive detection performance against state-of-the-art black-box detectors and enhanced interpretability through attention maps, contribution scores and concept intervention analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,DF-CBM在概念预测和深假探测方面都超过了基于概念的基线,同时通过注意地图、贡献分数和概念干预分析,实现与最先进的黑盒探测器相比的竞争性探测性能和增强可解释性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Deepfake Detection Methods
blocks.zh: 2.1 深假检测方法

blocks.en: Early deepfake detection methods focused on identifying visual inconsistencies introduced by face manipulation pipelines including physiological, geometric and boundary-related artifacts [ 65 , 29 ] . With the release of large-scale benchmarks [ 41 , 31 , 10 , 19 , 71 ] CNN-based detectors became the dominant paradigm. Several influential methods observed that face manipulation often introduces blending artifacts near facial boundaries leading to approaches such as Face X-Ray [ 29 ] and Self-Blended Images [ 44 ] which improve generalization by learning manipulation-independent cues.
blocks.zh: 早期的深假探测方法侧重于识别面部操纵管引入的视觉不一致,包括生理,几何和边界相关文物[65,29]. 随着大规模基准[41,31,10,19,71]的发布,基于CNN的探测器成为主导范式. 观察到的几种有影响力的方法,面部操纵经常引入靠近面部边界的混合文物,从而导致Face X-Ray [29] 和Self-Blended Images [44] 等方法,通过学习操纵-独立提示来改进概括性.

blocks.en: More recent work has shifted toward generalizable detection under unseen manipulation methods and datasets. UCF [ 62 ] disentangles common forgery cues from content- and method-specific artifacts, while LSDA [ 59 ] expands the latent forgery space to reduce overfitting to known manipulation patterns. Other approaches improve robustness through forgery augmentation [ 33 ] , discrepancy learning [ 66 ] , frequency debiasing [ 23 ] , frequency-guided adaptation [ 2 ] or adaptation of pretrained vision-language representations [ 7 , 28 , 46 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已转向在无形的操纵方法和数据集下进行普遍的探测。 UCF[62]将常见的伪造提示从内容和特定方法的文物中分离出来,而LSDA[59]则扩展了潜在的伪造空间,以减少过度适应已知的操纵模式. 其他方法通过伪造增强[33]、差异学习[66]、频率去除[23]、频率引导调整[2]或调整预先训练的视觉语言表述[7、28、46]来提高强度。

blocks.en: 2.2 Explainability in Deepfake Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 深假检测中的可解释性

blocks.en: Explainability in deepfake detection has been explored through visual evidence, prototype-based reasoning and localized explanation methods. Dynamic Prototype Networks [ 52 ] use temporal prototypes to explain video-level deepfake dynamics, while ProtoExplorer [ 4 ] provides a visual analytics interface for prototype-based forensic models. Other works localize decision-relevant facial evidence using local explanations or post-hoc analysis [ 45 , 54 ] . While such methods improve transparency over standard black-box detectors, they often explain predictions through saliency, prototypes or discovered concepts that are not explicitly constrained to correspond to predefined, human-interpretable manipulation concepts grounded in facial anatomy.
blocks.zh: 通过视觉证据,原型推理和局部解释方法,探索了深假探测中的解释性. 动态原型网络[52]使用时间原型来解释视频层深假动态,而ProtoExplorer[4]为原型法证模型提供了视觉分析界面. 其他作品利用本地解释或热量分析[45,54]将与决定相关的面部证据本地化. 虽然这些方法比标准黑盒探测器提高了透明度,但它们往往通过显赫性,原型或发现的概念来解释预测,这些概念没有明确被限制与基于面部解剖学的预先定义的,人可解释的操纵概念相对应.

blocks.en: A complementary line of work uses language supervision or multimodal large models to generate richer explanations of manipulated content. Specifically, Visual-linguistic face forgery detection [ 48 ] , DD-VQA [ 69 ] and ExDDV [ 15 ] introduce textual artifact descriptions, question-answering formulations and localized language annotations for explainable deepfake detection. Meanwhile, more recent methods and benchmarks [ 17 , 58 , 20 , 49 , 21 ] evaluate or exploit multimodal reasoning for detection, localization and explanation. However, free-form textual explanations may be weakly grounded in the image and can be difficult to verify spatially. In contrast, DF-CBM avoids unconstrained explanation generation by predicting a fixed set of manipulation concepts, each explicitly linked to anatomically meaningful facial regions.
blocks.zh: 一个互补的工作线使用语言监督或多式联运大型模型,对被操纵的内容作出更丰富的解释。 具体来说,视觉语言面部伪造检测[48],DD-VQA[69]和ExDDV[15]采用了文字文物描述,问答配方和局部语言说明,用于解释性深假检测. 同时,最新的方法和基准[17、58、20、49、21]评价或利用多式联运推理进行检测、定位和解释。 然而,自由形式的文字解释可能以图像为薄弱基础,在空间上可能难以核实. 相比之下,DF-CBM通过预测一组固定的操纵概念,避免了不受约束的解释生成,每个概念都明确与解剖有意义的面部区域相连.

blocks.en: 2.3 Concept Bottleneck Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 概念波特连克模型

blocks.en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide ante-hoc interpretability by constraining predictions to pass through an intermediate layer of human-understandable concepts [ 26 , 25 ] . This enables concept-level explanations and test-time interventions but early CBMs required dense concept annotations, limiting their scalability. Subsequent work has relaxed this requirement through richer concept representations [ 11 ] and weaker supervision [ 56 ] .
blocks.zh: Bottleneck Models(CFM)通过限制预测通过中间层人类可理解的概念[26,25],提供了事前的可解释性. 这使概念层面的解释和试验时间干预成为可能,但早期的建立信任措施需要密集的概念说明,限制其可扩展性。 随后的工作通过更丰富的概念表述[11]和较弱的监督[56]放宽了这一要求.

blocks.en: Recent CBM variants have further improved scalability and spatial grounding. Label-Free CBMs [ 38 ] and Post-hoc CBMs [ 68 ] leverage vision-language models and concept activation vectors to construct interpretable bottlenecks without dense manual annotations. Spatially-aware approaches, such as SALF-CBM [ 3 ] and locality-aware CBMs [ 18 ] extend CBMs from global concept activations to localized concept maps while CLIP-free extensions broaden their applicability beyond vision-language supervision [ 42 ] . Yet despite this progress, CBMs have not been systematically explored for explainable deepfake detection, where concepts must capture subtle manipulation artifacts and be grounded in anatomically meaningful facial regions.
blocks.zh: 最近的建立信任措施变体进一步提高了可扩展性和空间地面。 标签自由的建立信任措施[38]和后热的建立信任措施[68]利用视觉语言模型和概念激活载体,在没有密集的人工说明的情况下构建可解释瓶颈。 空间意识方法,如SALF-CBM[3]和地点意识的建立信任措施[18]将建立信任措施从全球概念激活扩展到局部概念地图,而无CLIP扩展则将其适用性扩大到视觉语言监督[42]。 然而,尽管取得了这些进展,但并没有系统地探索建立信任措施,以进行可解释的深层假象探测,在这种假象中,各种概念必须抓住微妙的操纵手段,并以解剖意义深远的面部区域为基础。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given an input face image, DF-CBM predicts a set of semantically meaningful manipulation concepts and uses them as an intermediate representation for final real/fake classification. The framework follows a two-stage pipeline. In the first stage, we construct a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts from text-enhanced deepfake datasets and associate each concept with plausible facial or boundary regions using large language models (LLMs). In the second stage, we train a region-aware concept bottleneck model to predict these concepts from frozen visual features while explicitly grounding each concept prediction in the corresponding facial regions.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个输入面像,DF-CBM预测了一系列精密有意义的操纵概念,并将其用作最终真实/假分类的中间代表. 该框架遵循两个阶段的管道。 在第一阶段,我们从文本增强的深假数据集构建了与操纵相关的概念的紧凑词汇,并利用大型语言模型(LLMs)将每个概念与可信的面部或边界区域联系起来。 在第二阶段,我们训练一个区域意识的概念瓶颈模型,从冷冻的视觉特征来预测这些概念,同时在相应的面部区域中明确地将每个概念预测设为基础.

blocks.en: 3.1 Concept Vocabulary Extraction and Region Mapping
blocks.zh: 3.1 概念词汇

blocks.en: The first stage of DF-CBM aims to construct a compact set of manipulation-related concepts and associate each concept with the facial regions in which is expected to appear. This produces a region-grounded concept vocabulary that is later used to guide the region-aware concept bottleneck.
blocks.zh: DF-CBM的第一阶段旨在构建一套紧凑的操控相关概念,并将每个概念与预期会出现的面部区域联系起来. 这产生了一个基于区域的概念词汇,后来用来指导区域认识的概念瓶颈.

blocks.en: We start from textual annotations in deepfake explanation datasets, including ExDDV [ 15 ] , DD-VQA [ 69 ] and FakeClue [ 57 ] . These annotations describe visual evidence of manipulation types in natural language. Given each text description annotation, we prompt Qwen3.5-9B [ 64 ] to extract atomic manipulation concepts that are concise visual cues that correspond to individual artifacts rather than full sentence-level explanations. The goal is to decompose complex descriptions into simpler concept candidates, such as eye artifacts, mouth distortions, boundary inconsistencies and global facial abnormalities.
blocks.zh: 我们从深假解释数据集中的文字说明开始,包括ExDDV [15],DD-VQA [69]和假Clue [57]. 这些说明描述了自然语言中操纵类型的视觉证据. 根据每个文字描述注释,我们请Quen3.5-9B[64] 提取原子操纵概念,它们是与单个文物相对应的简洁视觉提示,而不是完整的句子级解释. 目标是将复杂的描述分解为更简单的概念候选,如眼文物,口腔扭曲,边界不一致和全球面部异常.

blocks.en: The initial concept set is then filtered and consolidated to remove noisy and redundant entries. We first deduplicate the extracted concepts and encode them using EmbeddingGemma-300M [ 55 ] . The resulting embeddings are clustered using HDBSCAN to group semantically equivalent concepts. For each cluster, we select the top- k k entries closest to the cluster centroid and provide them to the same LLM which synthesizes a standardized concept label. The same top- k k entries and concept label are then used by the LLM to assign each concept to a predefined set of facial and boundary regions, corresponding to the regions extracted by the facial parsing model in Sec. 3.2 . This process yields a binary concept–region mapping A ∈ { 0 , 1 } K × R A\in\{0,1\}^{K\times R} , where K K is the number of concepts and R R is the number of facial and boundary regions. Each entry A k , r = 1 A_{k,r}=1 indicates that region r r is anatomically relevant for concept k k and may be used as visual evidence by the bottleneck model.

blocks.en: Finally, we remove rare concepts that occur in fewer than N min N_{\min} training samples, with N min = 750 N_{\min}=750 in our experiments. This filtering avoids training concept predictors for poorly supported concepts and improves the reliability of the final vocabulary. The vocabulary size is therefore governed by a trade-off between semantic granularity and supervisory density. Here, we favor a compact set of recurring manipulation cues that are sufficiently represented in the data, improving concept prediction robustness while preserving interpretability. After applying this criterion, the resulting vocabulary contains K = 6 K=6 concepts and serves as the semantic basis for the second stage of DF-CBM. Importantly, the architecture does not impose a fixed vocabulary size, allowing larger concept sets when sufficiently dense and reliable supervision is available.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们删除了在不到N min N_{\min}训练样本中发生的罕见概念,其中N min = 750 N_{\min}=750在我们的实验中. 这种过滤避免了对支持不足的概念进行概念预测的培训,提高了最终词汇的可靠性. 因此,词汇大小由语义颗粒性与督导密度之间的权衡决定. 在这方面,我们赞成一套在数据中得到充分体现的紧凑的经常性操纵提示,提高概念预测的稳健性,同时保持可解释性。 应用此标准后,由此产生的词汇包含K = 6 K = 6概念,并作为DF-CBM第二阶段的语义基础. 重要的是,该架构并不强制规定固定的词汇大小,在有足够密集和可靠的监督时允许更大的概念集.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: We train DF-CBM on the concept-annotated subset of FaceForensics++ [ 41 ] constructed using the concept extraction procedure in Section 3.1 . Following DeepfakeBench [ 63 ] , we use the c23 version for all experiments. All images are cropped and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . DF-CBM uses CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 39 ] as the image encoder and SegFace [ 37 ] with a Swin-Base backbone for facial region parsing. The attention and value dimensions, as well as the shared concept-evidence projection, are all set to 768 768 . The model is trained jointly for 15 15 epochs using AdamW [ 34 ] with a learning rate of 0.0002 0.0002 , batch size 128 128 , concept loss weight λ = 1.0 \lambda=1.0 and noise discount factor β = 0.15 \beta=0.15 on 2 RTX A6000 GPUs.

blocks.en: Following prior work [ 60 , 46 , 7 ] , we report frame- and video-level AUC for real/fake detection. For concept prediction, we report balanced accuracy (B-Acc.), F 1 F_{1} , frame-level AUC (F-AUC) and video-level AUC (V-AUC). We evaluate DF-CBM in a cross-method intra-dataset setting, training on FaceForensics++ and testing on eight unseen manipulation methods from DF40 [ 61 ] and in a cross-dataset setting using CDF-v2 [ 31 ] , DFD [ 8 ] , DFDC [ 9 ] , DFDCP [ 10 ] and UADFV [ 30 ] . We compare against the concept-based baselines Joint-CBM [ 26 ] and BotCL [ 56 ] , trained on the same concept-annotated subset as DF-CBM, as well as state-of-the-art black-box detectors using the reported results from [ 46 , 7 ] .

blocks.en: 4.2 Concept Prediction Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 概念预测结果

blocks.en: We first evaluate whether the learned bottleneck provides meaningful concept predictions. We compare DF-CBM with Joint-CBM [ 26 ] and BotCL [ 56 ] , on the FaceForensics++ test set. Evaluation is performed on all real test samples and on fake samples annotated with at least one concept from our vocabulary resulting in approximately 4.5 4.5 K real samples and 6.5 6.5 K fake samples.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评估所学到的瓶颈是否提供了有意义的概念预测。 我们在FaceForensics++测试集上将DF-CBM与联合CBM[26]和BotCL[56]进行比较. 对所有真实的测试样本以及至少带有我们词汇中一个概念的假样本进行了评价,结果产生了大约4.5K真实样本和6.5K假样本。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the macro-averaged results across all concepts in terms of balanced accuracy, F 1 F_{1} , F-AUC and V-AUC. DF-CBM outperforms both Joint-CBM and BotCL on F 1 F_{1} , F-AUC and V-AUC, achieving the largest gain in macro- F 1 F_{1} , with a 25.3% improvement over Joint-CBM, while maintaining comparable balanced accuracy. Overall, these results show that grounding concept prediction in anatomically relevant facial and boundary regions leads to a more reliable and interpretable concept bottleneck.

blocks.en: 4.3 Deepfake Detection Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 深假检测结果

blocks.en: We first evaluate video-level deepfake detection performance across different manipulation methods based on images from FaceForensics++. Table 2 compares DF-CBM with both state-of-the-art black-box detectors and concept-based baselines. For the black-box detectors, we report the results from [ 46 ] under the same evaluation protocol. For the concept-based baselines, Joint-CBM [ 26 ] and BotCL [ 56 ] are trained on the same concept-annotated subset of FaceForensics++ used to train DF-CBM.
blocks.zh: 我们首先根据FaceForensics++的图像,评价不同操纵方法的视频级深假检测性能. 表2将DF-CBM与最先进的黑盒探测器和基于概念的基线进行比较。 对于黑盒探测器,我们根据同一评估协议报告[46]的结果。 对于基于概念的基线,联合CBM [26] 和BotCL [56] 都接受了FaceForensics ++ 用于训练DF-CBM的同一概念附加说明子集的培训.

blocks.en: Among concept-based methods, DF-CBM achieves the best average video-level AUC, improving over both Joint-CBM and BotCL. Compared with black-box detectors, DF-CBM remains competitive, achieving the third-best average performance overall. Although the strongest fully black-box detectors still obtain higher AUC, this is expected because DF-CBM constrains the prediction to pass through a compact concept bottleneck. In return, DF-CBM provides explicit concept-level evidence and spatial grounding which are not available in standard black-box detectors.
blocks.zh: 在基于概念的方法中,DF-CBM实现了最佳平均视频级别AUC,比联合CBM和BotCL都有所改善. 与黑匣子探测器相比,DF-CBM仍然具有竞争力,实现了总体第三佳的平均性能. 虽然最强的全黑盒探测器仍然获得更高的AUC,但预计这是因为DF-CBM限制预测通过紧凑的概念瓶颈. 作为回报,DF-CBM提供了在标准黑箱探测器中没有的明确的概念级证据和空间定位.

blocks.en: Tables 3 and 4 report video-level and frame-level AUC, respectively, when testing the examined methods on unseen datasets. We report black-box detector results from prior work [ 46 , 7 ] . Notably, DF-CBM substantially outperforms the concept-based baselines across all target datasets. This improved performance is particularly important in the cross-dataset setting, where models must generalize beyond the manipulation methods and data distribution seen during training indicating that region-aware concept prediction provides a more transferable bottleneck than standard concept-based alternatives. Compared with SOTA black-box detectors, DF-CBM remains competitive, although the strongest unconstrained detectors still achieve higher AUC on several datasets due to the inclusion of the interpretable concept bottleneck layer in DF-CBM.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study

blocks.en: Table 5 ablates the main architectural components of DF-CBM on the intra-dataset evaluation set. Removing the region prior reduces the average AUC showing that the concept–region mapping provides useful spatial guidance for detecting manipulation concepts. Replacing concept-specific attention further lowers the average AUC to 0.845 0.845 indicating that allowing each concept to extract its own visual evidence is important for both concept prediction and final detection. Removing the concept bottleneck also degrades performance reducing the average AUC to 0.884 0.884 which suggests that explicit manipulation concepts provide useful semantic structure for detection.
blocks.zh: 表5列出了DF-CBM在数据集内部评价中的主要建筑组成部分。 将区域删除之前会减少AUC的平均值,显示概念-区域映射为探测操纵概念提供了有用的空间指导. 取代特定概念的注意进一步将平均AUC降至0.845 0.845,表明允许每个概念提取自己的视觉证据对概念预测和最终检测都很重要. 消除概念瓶颈也会降低性能,将平均AUC降低到0.884 0.884,这表明明确的操纵概念为检测提供了有用的语义结构.

blocks.en: We further study the query design used in the masked cross-attention mechanism. Table 6 compares randomly initialized learnable queries, frozen queries initialized from CLIP text embeddings and the full DF-CBM with learnable CLIP-initialized queries. The largest gain comes from text-based initialization suggesting that concept semantics help the model associate manipulation concepts with relevant visual evidence while allowing the initialized queries to be further refined during training provides a small additional gain.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步研究蒙面交叉注意机制中使用的查询设计. 表6比较了随机初始化的可学习查询,从CLIP文本嵌入中初始化的冻结查询和完整的DF-CBM与可学习的CLIP初始化查询. 最大的收益来自文本初始化,暗示概念语义学帮助模型将操纵概念与相关的视觉证据联系起来,同时允许初始化的查询在培训期间得到进一步的完善,提供了少量的额外收益.

blocks.en: 4.6 Interpretability via Intervention Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 通过干预分析的可解释性

blocks.en: To evaluate the influence and interpretability of the concept bottleneck layer, we implement a sequential intervention mechanism. For each facial concept, we estimate the empirical distribution of its predicted logits over the training set. To simulate concept activation and suppression while remaining within the range observed during training, intervention values are anchored to extreme quantiles of the corresponding logit distribution. Specifically, concept absence and presence are represented by the 1 s ​ t 1^{st} and 99 t ​ h 99^{th} percentiles, respectively. We target misclassified samples and intervene on one concept at a time, retaining each intervention before applying the next. For false real predictions concepts are sequentially set to their 99 t ​ h 99^{th} percentile intervention values, increasing evidence for deepfake artifacts and steering the prediction towards the Fake class. Conversely, for false fake predictions concepts are sequentially set to their 1 s ​ t 1^{st} percentile intervention values, suppressing artifact evidence and shifting the prediction towards the Real class.
blocks.zh: 为了评估概念瓶颈层的影响和可解释性,我们实施了一个顺序干预机制。 对于每一个面部概念,我们估计其预测的对数在训练集中的经验分布. 为了模拟概念的激活和压制,同时保持训练期间观察到的范围,干预值被固定在相应对数分布的极端量。 具体地说,概念的缺失和存在分别以1t 1^{st}和99t h 99^{th}百分位数为代表. 我们以错误分类的样本为目标,一次干预一个概念,在应用下一个概念之前保留每个干预。 对于虚假真实的预测,概念被依次设定到其99 t h 99^{th}百分位干预值,增加深假文物的证据,并将预测引导到假类. 反之,对于虚假的预测,概念被依次设定为1s t 1^{st)百分位干预值,压制文物证据,并将预测转向真类.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 illustrates the evolution of the raw class logits and corresponding softmax probabilities during sequential concept interventions for two randomly selected samples. As shown in Fig. 4(a) , a ground-truth real sample initially misclassified as fake exhibits little separation between the class logits after the first intervention. Subsequent concept interventions progressively decouple the logits, widening the decision margin and stabilizing the correct prediction. Conversely, Fig. 4(b) shows a ground-truth fake sample initially misclassified as real, where the first intervention immediately shifts the prediction across the decision boundary. Subsequent interventions further increase the target-class logit while suppressing the incorrect-class logit, resulting in steadily increasing prediction confidence.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck model for explainable deepfake detection. To address the gap between visually grounded evidence and language-based explanations, DF-CBM constructs a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts, associates each concept with anatomically meaningful facial and boundary regions and learns a concept-specific masked attention mechanism that grounds concept predictions in localized visual evidence. Through intra-dataset and cross-dataset evaluations, we show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in both concept prediction and deepfake classification while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art black-box detectors. Additionally, our qualitative and intervention analyses further provide interpretable evidence linking detected manipulation concepts to the final decision.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了DF-CBM,这是一种区域意识的概念瓶颈模型,用于解释性的深假检测. 为了解决视觉证据与语言解释之间的差距,DF-CBM构建了一个紧凑的与操控相关概念的词汇,将每个概念与解剖意义深远的面部和边界区域联系起来,并学习到一个针对特定概念的蒙蔽注意机制,将概念预测作为局部视觉证据的依据. 通过数据集内和跨数据集评价,我们显示,DF-CBM在概念预测和深假分类方面都超过了基于概念的基线,同时与最先进的黑匣子探测器保持竞争力. 此外,我们的定性和干预分析进一步提供了可解释的证据,将发现的操纵概念与最后决定联系起来。
